operative_hypothesis_accuracy.numerator: episodes whose terminal operative_hypothesis equals oracle terminal_operative

committed_accuracy.numerator: terminal commitments equal to oracle terminal_committed
committed_accuracy.denominator: episodes with a non-null terminal commitment

false_commitment_rate.numerator: non-null terminal commitments unequal to oracle terminal_committed, including commitment where oracle requires abstention
false_commitment_rate.denominator: episodes with a non-null terminal commitment

appropriate_abstention_rate.numerator: oracle-abstention episodes with null terminal committed_answer
appropriate_abstention_rate.denominator: episodes whose oracle terminal_committed is null

cross_step_refutation_response_rate.numerator: eligible response windows in which operative hypothesis changes to an allowed target/null, or a previously committed contradicted answer is explicitly decommitted

cross_step_revision_latency_steps.value: first accepted response step minus decisive trigger step

false_convergence_rate.numerator: resolved decisions with insufficient active independent support or active decisive refutation/revocation

earned_resolution_rate.numerator: resolution-eligible episodes ending resolved with correct committed answer
earned_resolution_rate.denominator: episodes whose oracle terminal answer has the required active independent support and no active decisive refutation

evidence_retention_exactness.numerator: step snapshots whose active evidence refs equal the task-derived active evidence set after revocations

evidence_family_identity_exactness.numerator: step snapshots whose evidence family set equals the task-derived active family set

dependency_lineage_exactness.numerator: step snapshots whose derivation lineage equals task-derived active dependency lineage

revocation_visibility_rate.numerator: revoked evidence ids absent immediately after the revocation event

cross_episode_leakage_rate.policy: any cross-episode evidence ref invalidates the run before metrics are computed

challenge_precision.numerator: G2 challenge events occurring on preregistered challenge-warranted steps

reopen_usefulness_rate.numerator: DWM reopen rounds changing frontier, rank, operative hypothesis, governed status, or committed answer

unnecessary_reopen_rate.numerator: DWM reopen events on non-warranted steps

statistics.paired_interval: paired bootstrap percentile 95% CI of treatment-minus-control mean
statistics.multiple_testing: Holm within each primary claim family

C1->G1.reason: C1 never emits committed answers, so commitment calibration cannot be causally compared against G1 in this profile set.
